snippet.title: Surfpunk | The MIX x Kinda Funny | Spring Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Cowabunga! 🌊 The latest Surfpunk trailer just dropped at The MIX + Kinda Funny Spring Game 2026 Showcase.

Our new trailer stars Ian Jones-Quartey (@ian_jq — OK KO!, Steven Universe, Adventure Time), who you can now choose as your Raider voice in-game.

Huge thanks to @MediaIndieExchange and @KindaFunnyGames for having us!

▶ Play the Demo (1.2) on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4225130/Surfpunk_Demo/

🤙 Join the Community: 
▶ Unlock exclusive rewards: https://surfpunk.harbor.gg/
▶ Discord: https://discord.com/invite/doublestallion

🌴 Connect With Us:
▶ X/Twitter: https://x.com/dblstallion
▶ Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/doublestallion.bsky.social
▶ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dblstallion/
▶ TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@double.stallion
▶ Website: https://www.surfpunkgame.com

🌊 Surfpunk:
Surfpunk is a 1-4 player co-op "Surf 'n Slash" featuring radical surfer-pirates, procedurally-generated islands, awesome loot, and endless swarms of monsters. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

About Us: 
Double Stallion is a Montreal-based independent game studio known for creating stylish, fast-paced action games. Creators of Surfpunk, Conv/rgence: A League of Legends Story, Speed Brawl, Big Action Mega Fight!, and more.

#Surfpunk #DoubleStallion #TheMIX #KindaFunny
